# Security Policy

## Supported versions

This is a portfolio/assignment project. Only the latest version on the `main` branch is maintained.

| Version | Supported |
|---------|:---------:|
| Latest (`main`) | Yes |
| Older commits | No |

## Reporting a vulnerability

Please **do not open a public issue** for security problems.

Instead, use GitHub's private reporting:

1. Go to the [Security tab](https://github.com/laveshparyani/Retail_Sales_Analysis/security).
2. Click **Report a vulnerability**.
3. Describe the issue, steps to reproduce, and potential impact.

You can expect an acknowledgement within a few days. Thank you for helping keep the project safe.

## Notes on this project

The dashboard reads local sample data files (CSV and Excel) and has no authentication or
user data, so its security surface is small. Dependencies are watched by Dependabot and the
code is scanned by CodeQL.
